rubric_source: The four equally weighted criteria supplied by the event participant

criteria.claim: A reviewed synthetic conversational correction reached kept data and a completed training job.
limitations: Fresh live trained-adapter inference is blocked.

criteria.claim: The implemented recurring task is short NPC dialogue generation; the proposed beneficiary is a game developer.
limitations: Developer demand and player benefit were not measured.
Synthetic operator-reviewed examples are not a user study.

criteria.claim: Backend, client, contract and learning-runner behavior can be checked locally with locked dependencies.
limitations: Local tests use mocks and do not prove current deployment behavior.
Public-launch safeguards and physical-device verification remain incomplete.

criteria.claim: The integrated frontend has a tested live preview, with diagnostic clients, labelled fixtures and a timed honest walkthrough.
limitations: No timed presentation rehearsal of this submission is claimed.
Production promotion and physical-device validation remain pending.
Fresh learned-model serving remains blocked; fixtures and recorded evidence are not live substitutes.
